name: University of Salamanca founded
summary: Alfonso IX of León establishes a Studium Generale at Salamanca by royal charter, the earliest such royal foundation in the Latin West. Alfonso X of Castile-León confirms and expands the statutes in 1254; Alexander IV grants the ius ubique docendi in 1255.

_quarry.structural_significance: Iberian peninsula's principal medieval university; later prepares the legal apparatus for the Castilian administration of the Indies.
